name: chelrecord-crossplatform
description: ChelRecord Studio desktop region selector, one-click recording, webcam and microphone capture

scripts.check: node --check main.cjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check renderer.js && node --check tests/verify-ffmpeg.cjs && node --check tests/ui-smoke.cjs && node --check tests/native-picker.cjs
scripts.test:ui: node tests/ui-smoke.cjs && node tests/ui-smoke.cjs native && node tests/ui-smoke.cjs native screen-denied

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: ChelRecord Studio uses a camera only when you enable its video preview or recording.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ChelRecord Studio uses the selected microphone for local recording.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: ChelRecord Studio captures the screen or window you explicitly select.
